# Ethereum Classic DAO

> Building the software and infrastructure for global adoption of Ethereum Classic — the largest Proof-of-Work smart contract platform. Wyoming DAO LLC ensuring US regulatory compliance.

## About

Ethereum Classic DAO LLC is the legal entity for the Olympia DAO under Wyoming's DAO LLC framework (Filing ID 2025-001671865). The LLC builds software, ecosystem infrastructure, and hashrate incentives for the world's largest Proof-of-Work smart contract platform — while ensuring proper reporting and compliance with US federal and state regulatory frameworks.

Ethereum Classic (ETC) is the only Proof-of-Work blockchain with native EVM smart contracts. Every Ethereum framework, library, and IDE works with Ethereum Classic — just change the chain ID (61 mainnet, 63 Mordor testnet). Network upgrades are coordinated to maintain EVM protocol parity, delivering a best-in-class EVM experience.

ETC is positioned not just as a digital commodity under the CLARITY Act, but as a compliant smart contract platform where regulated stablecoins (GENIUS Act) and ETF-aligned ERC-20 tokens can operate on a Proof-of-Work foundation.

## Legal Structure

- **Entity:** Ethereum Classic DAO LLC

- **Regulatory alignment:** CLARITY Act (digital commodity), GENIUS Act (stablecoins on EVM)

## Governance — Olympia Framework

The Olympia upgrade introduces protocol-level treasury funding and on-chain governance to Ethereum Classic.

**Treasury Funding:** 100% of EIP-1559 basefee funds the Olympia Treasury. Block rewards remain untouched — miners are unaffected.

**Governance Process:**
1. Propose — Community members submit governance proposals on-chain (permissionless)
2. Vote — Soulbound NFT holders cast weighted on-chain votes
3. Queue — Approved proposals enter a security timelock
4. Execute — After timelock, proposals execute automatically on-chain
5. Disclose — All outcomes publicly reported and verifiable

**Safeguards:** Configurable timelock, three-layer on-chain sanctions screening, soulbound (non-transferable) voting tokens.

## Network Statistics

- Hashrate: 170+ TH/s (largest PoW smart contract network, absorbed Ethereum mining infrastructure post-Merge)
- Markets: 300+ active markets across 20+ major global exchanges
- Independent clients: fukuii (Scala, primary), core-geth (Go), besu (Java)
- Network origin: July 30, 2015 (genesis block — oldest EVM-compatible blockchain)
- Chain IDs: 61 (mainnet), 63 (Mordor testnet)

## Client Implementations

Three independent implementations ensure zero single points of failure:
- **fukuii** — Purpose-built for Ethereum Classic. Independent implementation designed for performance, security, and protocol parity. Primary client for the Olympia upgrade.
- **core-geth** — The longest-running ETC client, forked from go-ethereum. Battle-tested stability across every network upgrade since genesis.
- **besu** — Enterprise-grade client built on Hyperledger Besu. Cross-client protocol verification and consensus compatibility validation.

## Developer Tooling (Full EVM Compatibility)

- Smart Contract Development: Hardhat, Foundry (forge/cast/anvil), Remix IDE, OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.x
- Client Libraries: ethers.js v6, viem, web3.js v4
- Wallets: 50+ wallet integrations including hardware wallets, browser extensions, and mobile wallets
- Infrastructure: Public RPC endpoints, block explorers, oracle networks
- Security: Slither, Mythril, Echidna
